svg.title: Symbol variants A: verdicts and input devices
svg.desc: Five alternative treatments per concept. Each cell is coded row-letter, for example 4C, so a choice can be named without describing it.

g.inkscape:label: 00 Paper
g.text: Verdicts and input devices. Five approaches each. Say the code, for example "4C", and it becomes the one in SYMBOLS.svg.
Sheet B has engine nouns and structural marks.

g.inkscape:label: 3 Missing
g.text: not there, has a gap ID

g.inkscape:label: 99 Footer
g.text: Squint test: if two rows are hard to tell apart at thumbnail size, the pair is wrong no matter how good each one looks alone.
